description: Employees using unsanctioned AI tools with company data, usually because the sanctioned option is missing or worse. Fixed by good sanctioned tools plus visibility, not by bans alone.
Uncontrolled proliferation of models, agents, MCP servers, prompts and keys with no owner: orphaned agents, credentials that outlive their owners, duplicated spend.
One credential used by many agents. It makes actions unattributable and impossible to revoke for one agent only.
The tendency to accept a system's suggestion without real scrutiny. It turns a high-volume human-in-the-loop step into a rubber stamp.
Where a control runs: the gateway (model calls), the harness (tool calls), CI and release (changes), or a scheduled process (reviews).
The international standard for an AI management system: policies, roles, risk assessment, controls and continual improvement, certifiable like ISO 27001.
